status: Three standalone Spine gate cycles authored and previewed; NOT integrated into gameplay
sequence: doors enter from opposite sides → collide and rebound → small stage shake → reopen → animated portal with demo reward → brief hold → reward removed → portal closes

timelineSeconds.impactShake: stage bone only; runtime camera wiring pending
timelineSeconds.sequence: slide in → crash + little shake → slide open → rotating portal/reward → reward removed → portal closes
timelineSeconds.source: intact native leaf used twice; right side mirrored, never clipped reference-only leaves

reward: Preview textbox only; no generated or modified math outcome. Runtime must supply authoritative reward with localization.
nativeArt: Full ready leaf-original PNG per mode; right bone mirrored. No clipped/reference-only art, no source pixel edits.
motion: Independent door bones, stage shake, rotating vortex, rocking rim, spring reward scale/fade; cosmetic impact jitter eventId-seeded
speed: Movement/outro obey live 1/1.5/3 speed; fixed 750ms full-opacity reward hold remains readable. No restart when speed changes.

tests.parser: All 22 art rigs parse in official Spine 4.2.74; exported endpoints finite
tests.coverage: offscreen starts, center collision/overlap, settle, mirrored native art, correct layering, deterministic small shake, portal spin/reward timing, all-clear endpoint, protected hold and boundary-crossing clock, ordered one-shot events, cancellation

build: PASS: static adapter exits normally; existing warnings retained
assetIntegrity: PASS: native inventory, geometry, SHA-256, font/OFL unchanged

browser.scope: Desktop workbench observation, not a mobile/production benchmark

resources.render: 30Hz, visible-canvas culling, hidden-tab pause, maxDPR2, paused/reduced-motion dirty-only draw
